name: To Darnassus

meta.previous: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit (Alliance)

summary: In Darnassus, you return to the Cenarion Enclave after your trial with the Great Cat Spirit. Having proved yourself to Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade, you come to Mathrengyl Bearwalker to learn cat form.

sections.title: Return to the Enclave
sections.body: You return to Teldrassil after meeting the Great Cat Spirit under Dendrite Starblaze's guidance in Moonglade. Starblaze has seen you prove yourself as a worthy student. So he sends you to your primary instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker. He waits beneath the boughs of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

sections.title: The Nature of the Cat
sections.body: In Darnassus, Mathrengyl Bearwalker sees the wisdom you gained from the Great Cat Spirit. Each generation of druids faces a trial shaped by this ancient spirit, playful yet deadly. Your bond is made, and your spirit is ready. Mathrengyl teaches you the final rites for taking cat form.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This is the final part of your trial with the Great Cat Spirit. After your time with Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade, you return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus. He teaches you to take cat form.

faq.q: Who sends you back to Darnassus?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze, a senior druid who lives in Nighthaven in Moonglade, sends you back after you receive the Great Cat Spirit's blessing.

faq.q: Where can I find Mathrengyl Bearwalker?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker waits in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus's northwestern quarter on Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the significance of the Great Cat Spirit?
faq.answer: The Great Cat Spirit is an ancient, feral spirit of nature, tied to agile and deadly predators. Druids must earn its favor and understand its playful yet lethal nature before they can channel its shape.

faq.q: Do all druids complete the exact same trial?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker says every druid must pass a trial granted by the Great Cat Spirit to master its form. The trials vary across generations.

faq.q: Can non-night elves take this quest?
faq.answer: This path is for Alliance night elf druids returning to Darnassus. Tauren druids follow their own path and report to their trainers in Thunder Bluff after visiting Moonglade.

angles.text: As a druid, cat form lets you channel the Great Cat Spirit directly.
As a night elf, your return to Darnassus honors the traditions the Cenarion Circle keeps beneath Teldrassil.
As an Alliance druid, you return from neutral Moonglade to Darnassus, strengthening your homeland's magical defenses.
